title: Affine etale restriction comparison preserving the adjunction unit
statement: For every family U_h of continuous functors between the full affine etale sites of schemes (for affine morphisms h:Y to X), natural identifications t_h: U_h followed by affine inclusion isomorphic to affine inclusion followed by ordinary etale base change, and left adjoints L_h with specified adjunctions a_h to affine precomposition on sheaves of Type(u+1), there are natural isomorphisms e_h: full-site inverse image followed by affine restriction isomorphic to affine restriction followed by L_h. On an affine object V and section s of a full-site sheaf G, e_h at U_h V carries the restriction along t_h(V) of the full-site unit on s to the affine unit on s. All these data and the explicit section formula are quantified in the Lean statement; no preservation or composition conclusion is asserted here.

source.place: Tag 04HR (lemma-alternative), with Sites 00WX, 00X1 and Categories 0B65; the adjoint transport implicit in the use of 04HR in Etale Cohomology 09YQ

proof.text: For each scheme S, restriction rho_S along the full affine inclusion is an equivalence of sheaf categories by 04HR. Use its quasi-inverse q_S and the units/counits of the adjoint equivalence. This holds for sets in the universe u+1 as well: the special-cocontinuity assertion is independent of the coefficient universe.

Write R_h for the full-site direct image and A_h for affine direct image. The natural isomorphism t_h induces R_h followed by rho_X isomorphic to rho_Y followed by A_h: on a sheaf F and affine V, the component is F applied contravariantly to t_h(V). Naturality follows from naturality of t_h. Compose the adjunction L_h -| A_h with the adjoint equivalences. In function-composition notation this makes q_Y L_h rho_X left adjoint to q_X A_h rho_Y. The preceding comparison and the equivalence counit identify this right adjoint with R_h. The conjugated inverse image and the full-site inverse image thus have isomorphic right adjoints.

Apply uniqueness of unit-compatible left-adjoint isomorphisms to obtain full-site inverse image isomorphic to q_Y L_h rho_X. Whisker with rho_Y and cancel q_Y using the equivalence counit to obtain e_h. The mate equation evaluated at the affine object V and section s is precisely e_h at U_h V applied to restriction along t_h(V) of the full-site unit, equal to the affine unit at V. This gives the displayed formula simultaneously for every h by choice.
